newsitem.title: UK: IBH sells interest in four UK hospitals.
newsitem.headline: IBH sells interest in four UK hospitals.

text.p: Independent British Healthcare Plc said on Monday that it had sold its interest in four hospitals in the UK to a consortium led by HSBC Private Equity Fund for a consideration of 7.6 million stg.
IBH received 7.05 million stg in cash and 0.55 million sg worth of loan stock in Abbey Hospitals Ltd, the company formed by HSBC for the purpose of the transaction.
IBH said the proceeds would be used partly to reduce its indebtedness and expand its existing 11 hospitals.
In another transaction, the group bought the freehold of the 45-bed IBH Victoria Park Hospital from Alliance & Leicester Building Society ALL.CN for 2.85 million stg.
